definitions.explanation: A book with illustrations, typically for young children. The pictures are the main content, with text playing a supporting role.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}に{絵本|えほん}を{読|よ}む。
examples.english: To read a picture book to a child.

examples.japanese: この{絵本|えほん}は{世界中|せかいじゅう}で{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: This picture book is popular around the world.

examples.japanese: {寝|ね}る{前|まえ}に、{母|はは}がいつも{絵本|えほん}を{読|よ}んでくれた。
examples.english: Before bed, my mother always read me a picture book.

notes:
{絵本|えほん} is composed of {絵|え} (picture) + {本|ほん} (book).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絵本|えほん}を{読|よ}む: to read a picture book
- {絵本|えほん}を{読|よ}み{聞|き}かせる: to read a picture book aloud (to someone)
- {絵本作家|えほんさっか}: picture book author/illustrator
